articleTitle: Dynamics and control of trajectory tubes. Theory and computation
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The solutions to a large array of recent problems in reachability and feedback control are presented in terms of trajectory tubes. Such tubes are all the more required in models of set-membership filtering, output feedback and team control under uncertainty. The topic of this report is the theory of trajectory tubes with related computation approaches.

articleTitle: Concurrent optimization of plasma shape and vertical position controllers for ITER tokamak
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Approach to concurrent plasma dynamics parametric optimization is presented. Trajectories ensemble set and composition of controllers of control system is considered for optimization of plasma dynamic. Optimization of ensemble border of perturbed motions is performed. Accounted ensemble of external influences set over time and initial deviations set. This approach solves the problem of concurrent optimization of the composition of controllers for plasma control. The results of numerical plasma dynamics optimization for ITER tokamak are discussed.

articleTitle: On optimization of the initial plasma stage in ITER
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The optimization of initial development of the plasma discharge in ITER is considered. To solve this problem the variation approaches are suggested.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of beam dynamics in linear accelerator with RFQ
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The problem of modeling and simulation of 3D beam dynamics in accelerators with RFQ is under consideration. The high frequency accelerating field is simulated using analytical approximations. The field of one “bunch” is calculated using the formula for two-body interaction of uniformly charged balls. To take into account the remaining part of the beam influence the analytical solution of the boundary value problem set for Poisson equation is applied.

articleTitle: Parallel beam dynamics simulation in injection systems taking into account particle interactions
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The problem of 3D beam dynamics simulation in injection systems is considered. Accelerating electrostatic field is simulated as a result of the solution of boundary value problem for Laplace equation by finite difference method. The computation of the beam field is based on the analytical solution of boundary value problem set for Poisson equation with use of MPI based parallel computations. High efficiency of the proposed computational method is shown in the examples.

articleTitle: Method of Lyapunov functions for controllable Hamiltonian systems
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Lyapunov function method is especially effective for controllable Hamiltonian systems. For such systems, control is chosen so that save the Hamiltonian form of the equations and the Lyapunov function is based on the Hamiltonian function. This approach allows us to achieve the Lyapunov stability of stationary solution.

articleTitle: Middleware transport architecture monitoring: Topology service
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a monitoring service technology for distributed infrastructure composed of hybrid cloud nodes or heterogeneous grid systems that allows developers to add extensions to transport middleware messaging patterns collection. We show role of topology service in organization of Peer-to-Peer network node communication.

articleTitle: The modeling of charged particle interactions in the elliptic beam
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this paper the mathematical model of the longitudinally non-uniform elliptic beam is presented. The trigonometric polynomial is proposed to model the charged particle beam density function. Analytical formulae for beam field intensity are proposed as a result of solving the boundary value problem for Poisson equation.

articleTitle: Plasma acceleration with external injection at SINBAD
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: SINBAD (Short INnovative Bunches and Accelerators at DESY) is a proposed dedicated accelerator research and development facility at DESY where amongst other topics laser-driven wakefield acceleration (LWFA) with external injection of ultra-short bunches will be exploited. At SINBAD we aim to demonstrate externally-injected bunch acceleration inside a plasma wake with minimal degradation of its energy spread and emittance at low plasma densities. To minimise induced energy spread, the bunch should occupy a small fraction of the plasma wavelength and has to be longitudinally synchronised with the laser driver to high accuracy. To avoid emittance growth the transport lattice for the incoming beam has to be matched to the intrinsic beta-function of the plasma. We present a preparatory feasibility study for future plasma experiments at SINBAD using simulations with the particle-in-cell code OSIRIS [1].

articleTitle: MPI-based software for charged particle beam dynamics simulation and optimization in the injection systems
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Simulation software for 3D beam dynamics and optimization in the injection systems is considered. Simulation of the MPI-based beam dynamics is accomplished on the basis of the “large” particle method. Accelerating electrostatic field is simulated by the finite difference method, in view of the injection system real geometry. For the beam field simulation both numerical solution of boundary value problem for Poisson equation and approximate analytical methods can be applied. To calculate the Coulomb field of the beam, both a numerical solution of the Poisson equation taking account of the electrodes configuration and approximate analytical methods are applied. A number of MPI-based numerical methods for multicriteria optimization are the integral part of this software.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Accelerator Driven Subcritical Reactor
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Dynamics with feedbacks of Accelerator Driven Subcritical Reactor (ADSR) is considered. Different ways of ADS control by accelerator are investigated. The response of ADSR to charged particle beam characteristic changes are obtained.

articleTitle: Global extremum search on the basis of density and its mode estimation
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Nonparametric density estimates may be used as a basis for construction of global random search algorithms. The distribution density reflects the main peculiarities of objective function behavior. Consequently, the density mode may be used as approximate argument value, providing objective function maximum.

articleTitle: Razumikhin approach to analyses of the differential-difference systems with linearly increasing time-delay
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A system of homogeneous differential-difference equations with linearly increasing delay is considered. The sufficient conditions of the asymptotic stability of the zero solution are given. Razumikhin's method to estimate the solutions is applied. The results can be used for the stabilization of controllable systems as well as the charged particle beams.

articleTitle: Exact penalty methods for nonsmooth optimization
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Methods of penalty functions are widely used in nonlinear programming. The idea of penalty function methods consists in reducing the problem of conditional optimization to a problem of the unconstrained optimization. Among the different approaches existing for such reduction we shall consider the method of exact penalty nondifferentiable functions. The implementation of exact penalty function methods first of all depends on the properties of an objective function and a function defining a constraint. Therefore various conditions are imposed on these functions to make it possible to solve our problem.

articleTitle: Integral-differential model of quasi-periodic beam longitudinal dynamics
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Longitudinal dynamics of quasi-periodic axial-symmetric beam is considered. Space charge density is simulated by trigonometric polynomial. The coefficients of this polynomial are expressed in terms of coordinates and velocities of model particles. Beam evolution with particle interaction account is described by the system of integral-differential equations.

articleTitle: Virtual electrophysics laboratories
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The authors present a complex of computer laboratories that simulates major subsystems of electrophysical facilities. Lab software interface creates a research environment with diverse electrophysical equipment, including assembly of the experimental circuits, setting their parameters and characteristics, starting and carrying out the necessary research. Models of subsystems are based on both mathematical modeling and use of tabular experimental data as well as features of real devices.

articleTitle: Optimizing a singular perturbed control system with incomplete information
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A linear - quadratic control problem for singular perturbed autonomous systems is considered. It's required to determine an optimal control under the lack of information about states, i.e. by using only the dominated states (full or not full measurements). In the paper there's used the approach when the optimal control is minimax. Some computational aspects arrising because of singularities are discussed.

articleTitle: Surface skin-current activated emission of electrons and ions
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Under the nano- or pico-second electric pulse irradiation, high-frequency magnetic isolation provides micrometer thickness of high-density skin-current layer at electroconductive surface of the bulk metal or semiconductor target. Hot electrons and acoustic phonons are generated and produce electron emission and anions (negative mode of extraction) or cations (positive mode) desorption.

articleTitle: Data processing in nuclear medicine
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The designed software makes it possible to capture and process data in static, dynamics, tomography and synchronization modes. The data processing allows qualitatively and quantitatively estimate the results of radionuclide studies.

articleTitle: Distributed computing system for solving charged particle beams physics problems based on the accumulated data
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The paper focuses on characteristics of building data-processing system for modeling and optimization of charged particle beams. The problems complexity and resource-intensive computing necessitates to reduce the calculation time. Need to use distributed computing. Technologically, the solution of this problem has a number of requirement: a system of complex data storage and processing, high performance computing techniques.

articleTitle: Sterilization installation electron beam dynamics optimization
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Some methods to increase efficiency of electron beam usage in sterilization installation, simulated by computer code “Beam Scanning”, are presented. These methods include a correction of the current waveform in deflecting magnet, forming slightly convergent electron flow and irradiation of lateral object sides by low-energy electrons in the energy spectrum.

articleTitle: The field gun with the thin emitter mathematical modeling
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The field gun with the thin emitter is under investigation. The field emitter is an infinitely thin line on the plane substrate, anode is a plane. The Laplace's equation is solved in cylindrical co-ordinates for all area of the field gun.

articleTitle: Electron beam dynamics simulation in the compact 27 Ghz 6 Mev linac
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A biperiodical accelerating structure of compact electron accelerator with operating frequency 27 GHz will consider, results of the beam dynamics simulation will presented and the electrodynamics characteristics of the resonator will discussed. Also will be investigated the dynamics of the beam in the buncher and in the main section, the optimal parameters will choose. It will be shown that the energy equal to 6 MeV can be obtained at the section length of 50 cm. The current capturing coefficient is higher than 80%, after optimization.

articleTitle: Application of high-performance software complex to accelerating structures optimization problems using the accumulated data
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The paper focuses on the optimization approach to solving accelerating structures design problems based on the accelerating structures data, accumulated using distributed computing on a high-performance complex. Approach is examined in the example of choosing admissible controls model for longitudinal motion of charged particles in RFQ accelerators.

articleTitle: Code development for calculation of self-coordinated beam dynamics in dielectric wakefield accelerators
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A dynamics of relativistic electron beams in a single layer cylindrical waveguide with dielectric filling is investigated. The computer code is developed based on mathematical expressions for the analysis of the radial dynamics. Influence of both wake fields and a focusing system on bunch dynamics are analyzed.

articleTitle: Asymptotically invariant sets in the systems of differential equations with perturbations
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: This work is devoted to studying the behavior of solutions of systems of non-linear differential equations with unbounded increase of time. We give some sufficient conditions for the existence of asymptotically invariant sets for systems of differential equations of a certain type.

articleTitle: Numerical optimization of RFQ channel
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A simple control model for beam in RFQ channelis considered. This model is based on the previously developed approach [1]and allows to perform optimization of the RFQ channel in acceptable time.1. O.I. Drivotin, D.A. Ovsyannikov. Modelingof high intensity charged particle beams. St. Petersburg, St. Petersburg State Univ., 2003.

articleTitle: Qualitative analyses of attainability set of nonlinear controllable systems
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Let us consider a nonlinear system x = f (t, x) + g (t, x)u (1) where the vector-function f(t, x) is defined and continuous in the domain D = {(t, x) | t ≥ 0, x ∈ R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>}. We presuppose in addition, that f(t, x) is a homogeneous vector-function of order m > 1 of the argument x. It has the continuous and bounded partial derivatives ∂f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>(t, x)/∂x<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub>, ij = 1, n in the domain G = {(t, x) |t ≥ 0, ||x|| ≤ H} for any H > 0.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of variations in the geomagnetic field of the earth
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: We consider the variation of the geomagnetic field of the Earth, caused by the movement of sea water as a conductive medium. Based on the proposed model and hydrodynamic interaction of electromagnetic fields with the help of the software package ANSYS calculation is made and the subsequent analysis of the response from fairly well-studied hydrodynamic object-surface waves.

articleTitle: Comparison of injection algorithms for electron beam simulation by particle-in-cell method
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Algorithms of macroparticles injection into particle-in-cell computational domain for electrons beam simulation are studied. Models for Fawler-Nordheim and Gauss laws as well as constant current density injection are compared. The geometry of coaxial-cylinders diode for test-aimed device is used. In space charge limited regime Gauss law and constant current density injection are similar in resulted beam dynamics. The Fawler-Nordheim injection function, implemented in XOOPIC, is more appropriate for simulation of field emission generator of electrons beam both in cases of space charge limited and unlimited regimes.

articleTitle: On optimization problem in electrostatic field
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The problem of optimization of charged particle beam dynamics in superposition of an axially symmetric electric and space-charge and a given external fields is considered. The space-charge field and the external field not required to be axially symmetric. The complex potential of the electric field is represented with use a Cauchy integral of a control function defined on the boundary of complex region. Analytical representation of functional variation is found and the optimality conditions are formulated.

articleTitle: Approximation of asymptotic stability domain for differential-difference systems with time delay
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The asymptotically stability domain for nonlinear systems of differential-difference equations is approximated by the domain of asymptotically stability for difference equation systems. The algorithm for estimating the asymptotically stability domain for a difference system is developed and it is based on the Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional method. The method of asymptotically stability domain mapping in functional space is proposed. An example is given to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: Project of an installation for radiation-thermal processing of natural organic materials
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The present paper considers a project of an installation intended for processing of natural organic materials into liquid products, which can be used as an engine fuel or raw materials for industrial organic synthesis.

articleTitle: Residual gas ionization by means of accelerated deuterons beam
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Computer simulation of neutron tube residual gas ionization by means of accelerated deuterons beam has been fulfilled. Fully relativistic electromagnetic particle-in-cell finite-difference, time-domain cod SUMA has been used.

articleTitle: Transverse dynamics of the relativistic electron beams passing through coaxial cylindrical dielectric waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Transverse beam dynamics is a critical issue for the wakefield accelerating structure development. The passing length of the driving high current low energy bunch, which generates wakefields, is dominated by strong deflecting field of HEM (Hybrid Electro Magnetic) modes. Properly adjusted FODO focusing system allows to keep the bunch off the dielectric walls along the waveguide axis. We present here our investigation results on the high order (m>1) HEM modes effect on the transverse beam dynamics of the driving 20-30 nC beam. Our analysis was carried out with the help of the in-house code BBU'3000 especially developed for the dielectric loaded wakefield accelerator. The calculation results will be used for the newly updated Argonne Wakefield Accelerator for experiments with the 75 MeV electron drive beams.

articleTitle: Cellular automaton simulating of the intensive charged particles beam evolution
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this research we formulate and formalize the rules for the cellular automaton that simulates the evolution of the intensive elementary charged particles beam considering the self-Coulomb field of the beam for an n-dimensional case. In this research we also describe the main principles of the realization of this approach and corresponding algorithms for a parallel cluster environment. The program realization of represented algorithms and some results of computing are described.

articleTitle: Current level of research and development of the sources with a plasma emitter for generation a continuous focused beam with high brightness
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The paper discusses the main achievements in development of effective electron-beam discharge sources for generating the focused electron beams with high brightness. There were considered the distinguish features of described sources from the thermionic guns. Possibilities sources with a plasma emitter and prospects of their use in electron-beam technology are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of the initial plasma stage in ITER
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Mathematical model of the initial plasma stage control problem in ITER is considered. Geometrical and physical parameters of ITER vacuum camera and electro-magnet system are taken into account during the modelling process. The laws of voltage variation on the control coils during the discharge, its initial current values and resistances are considered as control functions.

articleTitle: Compton sources
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The present state of X-ray and gamma sources, based on Compton backscattering is presented. Main parameters of Kharkov X-ray generator NESTOR are described. Application prospects Compton sources are discussed.

articleTitle: Beam dynamics in the NICA collider rings
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Accelerator complex NICA, developed at JINR, will provide an ion-ion (Au79+) collisions at energies of 1-4.5 GeV/u. The collider characteristics and the beam dynamics have been worked out to create appropriate conditions for the collisions of beams and obtaining the required luminosity parameters in the working energy range.

articleTitle: Correct investigation of the influence of fringe fields in the ion-optical systems
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: We present an analytical approach that shows how fringe field aberrations depend on parameters of control elements (dipoles, quadrupoles, and so on). The used approach is based on both analytical presentation of matrix transfer maps and different models for fringe fields. The suggested approach is based on parametric investigations in the symbolic mode for necessary objects. Here we used some automatically procedures for necessary computations.

articleTitle: Solution of equation of self-coordinated beam dynamics in dielectric wakefield structures
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: An analytical solution of self-coordinated beam dynamics equation is developed. The high current relativistic electronic bunches are used for generation of wake fields in wakefield structures with dielectric filling. Propagation under influence of both own beam created by dipole modes of Cherenkov field and outer focusing and deflecting fields is investigated. The received solutions can be used for a fast assessment of flight range of a bunch in dielectric wakefield structure.

articleTitle: Multispeed electron beams (Methods of formation, investigation of structure, used for the microwave generation)
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental study of multispeed electron beams are considered. Efficient methods for the formation of such electron beams are proposed. An overview of the using of multispeed electron beams to generate and amplify microwave signals of different complexity is provided.

articleTitle: Development of ECR multicharged ion sources for accelerators
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Several types of ECR ion sources for production of intense multicharged ion beams of gaseous and solid materials in the mass range He - Bi with the intensity more than 1mA (for Ar8+) are described. The axial magnetic field is created by the water cooled copper coils, or superconducting coils. The radial magnetic field is created by the permanent magnet (NdFeB) system. For the plasma heating a microwave generators with the frequency of 14 GHz or 18GHz are used.

articleTitle: Analysis of space charge dynamics in terms of HPC
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The evaluation of self-field effects on beam dynamics requires GPU-time intensive numerical simulations. The natural parallel and distributed structures of beam physics problems allow using parallel and distributed copmuter systems. In this case the use of high-performance computing is required. To deal with time consuming calculations, a special algorithm for predictor-corrector method for beam including space-charge forces was used.

articleTitle: Parametric optimization of particle separation systems
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this paper we discuss some problems and corresponding methods for the optimal design of a M/Q separator that can be used to separate highly charged ions. We consider the enough traditional mass-separator structure, consisting of some magnetic and electrostatic devices to obtain a high order achromatic system. The discussed approach is based on the matrix formalism for Lie algebraic methods and allows providing the comprehensive investigation of desired structures.

articleTitle: IH-type drift tube structures parameters investigation
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Accelerating-field focusing linacs are now considered to be of remarkable practical importance. Alternating-phase focusing (APF) accelerator based on IH resonator is one of this kind. We make a study of the main parameters of IH resonator from the synchronous phase sequence. The results of the beam dynamics simulation in the standing wave field are presented.

articleTitle: New station for optical observation of electron beam parameters at electron storage ring Siberia-2
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to a new station for optical observation of electron beam parameters which was built at the synchrotron radiation (SR) storage ring SIBERIA-2 at Kurchatov Institute. The station serves for the automatic measurement of electron bunches transverse and longitudinal sizes with the use of SR visible spectrum in one-bunch and multi-bunch modes.

articleTitle: Development of software for optimization of operating mode at product processing by scanned electron beam
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: On the basis of the PENELOPE-2008 transport code, a software for modeling the interaction of a scanned electron beam with an object moving via the irradiation zone has been developed. The SW takes into account the spatial radiant distribution of the particles depending on the form of the beam scan and its spectrum. It is shown, that proper selection of the scan form provides a reduction of the dose uniformity ratio within the processed object.

articleTitle: Cavity excitation equations in terms of external parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Electromagnetic field in the cavity excited by moving charge can be expressed in the form of expansion on cavity eigen functions,time dependent coefficients being the solutions of the second order differential equations set. The transformations have been made to represent exciting terms in the form of cavity external parameters.

articleTitle: The solution of one problem of minimizing a quadratic function using the method of exact penalty
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The problem of conditional minimization of quadratic functions with positive definite matrix on the set specified by inequality is considered. For solution of the problem is proposed to use the method of exact penalty functions. Based method that minimizes the penalty function with constant step and have a geometric convergence rate is similar in the smooth case, the gradient method of minimization of convex functions. To find the direction of descent is solved quadratic programming.

articleTitle: The final magnetic field distribution of the 80 MeV H-minus isochronous cyclotron at Gatchina
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The final parameters of the magnetic field distribution of the new H-minus cyclotron obtained as well a result of 3D computer calculations as experimental measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Optimization of support grid for extraction window in electron accelerator
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A system for the beam raster-scanning is used in the accelerator. To reduce the beam losses, a support grid with wedge-shaped ribs of varying tilt angles is used. The GEANT4 code was applied to simulate the transmission of electrons through the grid and the foil supported by the grid. The total energy losses for different rib geometry have been evaluated, and the non-uniformity of the foil thermal load has been studied.

articleTitle: Ensemble of ions and electrons in the electric field
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Selfconsistent problem acceleration ions flow with present electron flow and cloud of electrons with zero average velocity are studied. One used kinetical description of electron flow in case, when distribution of electrons depends not only on integrals of motions. Cold ions can by accelerated to energy, exceed temperature of electrons.

articleTitle: Beam dynamics simulation in high-power high-energy accelerator-driver of the proton beam
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The design of linear accelerator-driver of the MW and 1-1.5 GeV proton beam is the main problem in accelerating driven systems (ADS) design. The results of beam dynamics simulation in such linac will present. Linac will consist of RFQ, RF focusing section and SC modular configuration sections.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling of magnetohydrodynamic flow in the channel
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The flow of a conducting fluid in a channel of square section under the action specified in a certain section of the electric voltage - potential difference and the external magnetic field. Numerical solution by using software package ANSYS. Analyzes the mutual influence of the electromagnetic and hydrodynamic fields associated with the emergence of self-magnetic field induced by the motion of the medium.

articleTitle: Application of ion beam cooling in the NICA accelerator complex. Experimental study of stochastic cooling at Nuclotron, JINR (Dubna)
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The project of Nuclotron-based Ion Collider fAcility NICA/MPD (MultiPurpose Detector) is under development at JINR (Dubna) now. The general goals of the project are providing of colliding beams for experimental studies of both hot and dense strongly interacting baryonic matter and spin physics (in collisions of polarized protons and deuterons).

articleTitle: Dynamics of Sheet Electron Beam Angular Portrait During Its Movement in the Stray Field of a Magnetic Film with Stripe Domain Structure Accompanied by Electron Impacts with the Film Surface
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: As a result of numerical simulation of sheet electron beam scattering by thin magnetic film with stripe domain structure, the angular portraits (the set of polar and azimuthal angle values which describes particle movement) for different beam scattering stages have been defined. A focusing effect of magnetic film field dependence on domain structure period and initial beam orientation has been investigated.

articleTitle: Steady-state solutions of the diode with two flows of particles of unlike charges, entering from opposite electrodes
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Planar diode in which positive and negative charged particles with monoenergetic velocity distribution functions are supplied from opposite electrodes and move with no collision in the interelectrode spacing under self-consistent electric field is studied. A total classification of the potential distributions is obtained. It has been found that several steady-state solutions can exist under the same parameters of the beams.

articleTitle: An effective numerical scheme for parabolic partial differential equations
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: An effective scheme for parabolic equations is proposed and investigated. It is based on the second order Rosenbrock scheme for the independent coordinate with a special procedure of matrix pseudoinversion and a three node one with a Numerov's corrector for the Laplacian.

articleTitle: Upgraded method of “active correlations” for dynamic background suppression
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: New detection system design for heavy element research with 48Ca projectile has been reported. This system is based on application of 32 position sensitive strip PIPS detector and low pressure pentanefilled TOF detector application in 48 Ca induced nuclear reactions. To suppress beam associated with background products a new version of real-time method of “active correlations” has been applied. Namely with this technique and respective dynamic beam manipulation procedure, it has became possible to provide a deep background suppression in heavy ion induced nuclear reactions. Examples of applications in 249Bk+48Ca and 243Am+48Ca reactions are presented. The system development to operate together (in parallel) with the digital ORNL detection system to provide a quick search for ERalpha correlation chains has been discussed too. In that case the system operates with DSSSD large area Micron Semiconductors detector.

articleTitle: Formation of high-energy beams of electrons
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: If a gas discharge device is connected to the circuit with inductive energy storage, the current interruption results in electrons acceleration towards the anode by the increasing field. That allows to use such a device for the purpose of electron beam generation. Studies were carried out up to the 90 kV voltage. The results of electron beam mathematical modeling under the conditions of the electric field increasing are presented.

articleTitle: Development of an integrated theory of field emitter optics
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: This paper reports progress in developing an integrated theory of field emitter optics that covers both electron and ion emission (including liquid metal ion sources and atom probe tomography). Issues covered include resolution theory, Hawkes-Kasper angular magnification, discrepancies in brightness theory, and whether reduced brightness really is a conserved quantity.

articleTitle: Design of APF linac on the base of optimization approach
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The optimization approach to obtain the synchronous phase sequence in APF structure is suggested. The project of APF linac is discussed. The result of beam dynamics simulations are presented.

articleTitle: Accelerators for radiation technologies at the D.V. Efremov Institute of electrophysical apparatus
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Development of the particle accelerators and accelerator-based electro-physical structures are among the main directions of the scientific research at the Efremov Institute. A whole range of accelerator devices was developed in the Institute - designed, manufactured and installed in scientific, producing and health organizations are over 300 of different kinds of accelerators - cyclotrons, linacs, direct-action accelerators and neutron generators.

articleTitle: The beam vertical focusing at injection on the centre of isochronous cyclotron
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The spiral inflector is used in an external injection system of isochronous cyclotrons for beam rotation from axial channel to cyclotron median plane. Common problem of spiral type inflector is vertical defocusing of the injected beam. At the present work the ways of compensation of the beam defocusing, used in FLNR cyclotrons, are presented.

articleTitle: Optimization of beam parameters in RFQ channel
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Associated codes the BDO-RFQ and the LIDOS RFQ for optimization parameters of RFQ channel are used. As an example, beam dynamics simulation results for 47.2 MHz RFQ accelerator are discussed.

articleTitle: Waves in a rotating layer of an ideal electrically conducting incompressible fluid with allowance effects of diffusion of magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A system of nonlinear partial differential equations is considered that models perturbations in a layer of an ideal electrically conducting rotating fluid bounded by spatially and temporally varying surfaces with allowance for inertial forces and diffusion of magnetic field. The system is reduced to a scalar equation. The solvability of initial boundary value problems arising in the theory of waves in conducting rotating fluids can be established by analyzing this equation. Solutions to the scalar equation are constructed that describe small-amplitude wave propagation in an infinite horizontal layer and a long narrow channel.

articleTitle: Modeling of guiding of 10 keV electron beam by planar dielectric surface
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Study of 10 keV electron beam reflection from a single planar dielectric surface was made. Guiding effect for some part of the beam was observed within grazing angles of incidence. Ionization, electron emission and drain of the surface charge were considered in the computer model to explain the results.

articleTitle: MODE software for nonlinear spin-orbit dynamics simulation in electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Nonlinear matrix integration as a mapping approach for ordinary differential equations solving provides powerful technique for particle dynamics simulation. The numerical implementation of this method provides by MODE software package. In this program one can build a matrix map for particles spin-orbit motion in arbitrary electromagnetic fields.

articleTitle: The magnetic field grows estimation at the 3D-ferromagnetic near of the corner point
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The 3D integral magnetostatic problem at the ferromagnetic near of the corner point is considered. The asymptotical grows of the magnetic field near of the corner point is obtained. The adapted mesh near of the corner point is proposed.

articleTitle: The method of electrostatic and electromagnetic fields calculation
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The effective method of calculation the electrostatic and electromagnetic fields is developed. The method is approved in the analysis of parameters field the emitter of laffices and wave guides with a curvilinear cross contour. High efficiency of calculation is provided. Accuracy of performance of boundary conditions makes 3-7 signs after a comma.

articleTitle: Computations of accelerating structure for updated UELR-6D accelerator
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The accelerator is intended for non-destructive testing in heavy engineering industry. A biperiodic electrodynamic structure with inner (axial) coupling cells is used as accelerating device. Computations of an accelerating structure with a reduced beam injection energy and unified geometrical parameters of resonator cells have been performed. The computation results of the electromagnetic field, coupling slots and beam dynamics are given.

articleTitle: NICA project — Challenges and tasks
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The project of Nuclotron-based Ion Collider fAcility (NICA) is being under development at JINR (Dubna). The general goals of the project are providing of colliding beams for experimental studies of both hot and dense strongly interacting baryonic matter and spin physics (in collisions of polarized protons and deuterons). The report contains description of the facility scheme and characteristics in heavy ion operation mode, MPD detector scheme and characteristics, status and plans of the project development. A high emphasis is placed on the problems of high brightness beam formation and providing of a high luminosity of the NICA collider. To reach the project luminosity at heavy ion collisions an application of particle beams' cooling methods — both electron and stochastic ones, is proposed and being developed.

articleTitle: The exact solutions of the nonlinear space charge problem
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: It is need to take into account the space charge beams effect by the high intensity beam modeling and optimization. In this paper the exact solutions for the space charge problem for the simplest geometrical areas is obtained.

articleTitle: Beam dynamics in neutron tubes ion-optic system
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Computer simulation of deuteron beam dynamics in typical neutron tube ion-optic system has been carried out. The result obtained are in a good agreement with conducted experiments.

articleTitle: Controllable laser ion acceleration
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: When an intense laser illuminates a target, temporarily a strong electric field is formed, and the target ions are accelerated. The control of the ion energy spectrum and the ion particle energy, the ion beam collimation and the ion beam bunching are successfully realized by a multi-stage laser-target interaction.

articleTitle: Visualization of particle tracks and geometry of NICA/MPD experiment by means of FROG software
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In 2017 year collider from project NICA is going to start working. Needs software for it correct work and data handling, in particular, for visualization particle tracks and geometry of Many Purpose Detector. This software was realized. It based on FROG package.

articleTitle: Implementation of optimization algorithm in Cosy Infinity for charged particle dynamics in electrostatic field
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The problem of realization of optimization algorithm for charged particle dynamics in an axially symmetric electric field is considered. The complex potential is represented as a Cauchy integral of a function defined on the boundary of the region and considered as the control function. The Cosy Infinity software package is used for the algorithm implementation.

articleTitle: Optimal parameters selection for transportation channels of relativistic beams
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The authors present method of calculation of optimal parameters of the magneto-optical systems using extreme methods of searching. Particle dynamics in transportation channel is described by the matrix formalism using programming system MATLAB. The calculation consists of two stages: preselection of quadrupole lenses and focusing system geometry; determine of optimal system parameters by Nelder-Mead method.

articleTitle: Investigation of coupled RF cavities operation of storage ring Siberia-2
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The RF system of the storage ring Siberia-2 includes three accelerating cavities. The paper describes a coupled cavity model, which allows for errors in a design of a coaxial line and matching of cavities with transferring path, not considered in the feedback system, that could cause incorrect operation of the RF system.

articleTitle: Beam optics design and optimization of a compact focusing system for future colliders
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A novel final focus system based on local chromaticity correction was proposed in 2001 and has been recently successfully verified at the ATF2 facility at KEK, Japan.

articleTitle: Statistical and algebraic analysis of the transfer matrices errors
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this paper we consider two methods for assessing the impact of errors in the adjustment of control parameters in accelerator systems. These methods are based on two methods of investigation of errors of control parameters. The first of them is based on the well known method of the statistical analysis and the second - on the algebraic analysis of the transfer matrix. These approaches are naturally encapsulated in the Virtual Accelerator concept.

articleTitle: 3D simulation of electric field in the inflector of CC-12 cyclotron
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The inflector is intended to inject the beam formed by the external injection system into the central area of the cyclotron along the helical trajectory. The quality of the inflector simulation significantly affects the characteristics of the accelerated beam. Different geometrical models describing field-forming elements of the inflector are given in the paper. The results of the field computations with the ANSYS and ISFEL3D codes are given.

articleTitle: Advanced simulation tools for muon-based accelerators
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: New software tools are being developed incorporating the most accurate theoretical calculations and experimental data available for crucial and not-yet-considered physics processes specific to muon accelerators. This will substantially enhance the confidence that the tools used in assessing the feasibility of a muon collider or a neutrino factory accurately represent the performance of a real machine. Current status and progress are reported.

articleTitle: Optical scheme development for ITEP proton microscope based on a beam with 9 GeV energy
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Proton radiography facility based on a beam with energy 9 GeV is supposed to be developed in ITEP for investigation of the static and dynamic objects. The microscope optical scheme is proposed. The scheme consists of 6 quadrupole ML-15 type magnetic lenses and allows to obtain the images with spatial resolution 10 microns, the beam field of view having the linear size about 20 mm.

articleTitle: The automation of working cycle for the KCSR main synchrotron
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The running cycle of Kurchatov Synchrotron Radiation Source main ring includes the injection of electrons from the booster, the accumulation of an electron current, energy ramping up to 2.5 GeV without the extraction. The database describing logic channels of the control, modes of the technological systems and the script of the running cycle of an accelerating facility is developed. Examples of realization of the software used in operative work KSRS are given.

articleTitle: Automation of the matrix formalism the field equations and equations of motion
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this paper we are considering the problem of automated construction of symbolic representations of objects needed for modeling (analytical and numerical) control systems for charged particle beams. The basis of the approach is the matrix formalism for Lie algebraic methods describing the evolution of the particle beam as a collective object in the nonlinear electromagnetic fields.

articleTitle: Experimental study of pulsating electron beams
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The multispeed electron beams with periodically varying diameter can be used to create a broadband amplifier and generator tubes. The experimental results showed the possibility of transition from generation to gain due to the formation a number of local droops of capacity in pulsating electron beams.

articleTitle: Angiography X-ray source based on electron channeling in crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The article concerns the new method of acquiring the narrow energetic spectrum based on the idea of electron channeling in crystals. Polycapillary X-ray filter exploited in this method helps to eliminate the high-energy part of the spectrum and obtain dramatically reduction of the absorbed doses.

articleTitle: Influence of electrostatic multipoles on spin-orbit dynamics via energy conservation consideration
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The energy conservation law leads to the fact that a charged particle moves with nonconstant kinetic energy in the electrostatic fields. The article considers a technique of representation of this motion in terms of pseudo magnetic fields with additional multipole components and constant particle velocity.

articleTitle: Field and trajectory analyses and optimization of magnetic shielding for neutral particle diagnostics in ITER
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A diagnostic system of the neutral particle analyzer has been developed under the Ioffe Institute supervision for the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER). A numerical experiment is presented aimed to analyze the diagnostics operability in harsh electromagnetic environment and optimize its design and performance. A care was taken to integrate the diagnostic system with the ITER machine structures.

articleTitle: Application of compact ion linacs
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: There are considered possible application for medical systems compact ion linacs with RFQ and APF accelerating structures working in p-frequency diapason.

articleTitle: The results of experimental and theoretic investigation moment of ignition of ion-plasma DAS engines with thermoionic neutralization cathodes
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this work we consider the transitive process of ignition of discharge in crossed fields in the anode layer type hall thruster with thermionic cathodes. It is shown in experiments that at the moment of ignition anode (and cathode) current is much larger than at steady state regime. The value<;br/>of current impulse is in direct ratio and the duration of this process in inverse ratio of cathode emission current. The numerical kinetic modeling of this process shows that so large ignition current explained by two mechanisms: fast ionization of dense gas in discharge channel and practically full demagnetization of plasma by self-field of hall current.

articleTitle: Beam optics in self oscillating back Compton generator
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Superconducting energy recovery linac as well as free electron laser (FEL) and back Compton scattering are used to generate electromagnetic radiation in Roentgen range. Beam splitting technique is used to prepare two non disturbed electron beams for two resonator arms, the details of this being the subject of the paper.

articleTitle: Nonlinear corrections in the CR storage ring at FAIR
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The large acceptance Collector Ring at FAIR is designed to provide a stochastic pre-cooling of either antiprotons (Pbar) or Rare Isotopic Beams (RIB) injected in the ring. In addition, for mass measurement of exotic short-lived nuclides, the CR will be tuned in the special isochronous ion-optical setting, in which it will be used as a Time-Of-Flight (TOF) spectrometer. In order to reach necessary time resolution, the octupole corrector magnets will be installed in the CR. The nonlinear field imperfections of the magnets and fringing fields of the wide aperture quadrupole magnets excite high-order chromatic aberrations, which lead to the beam losses. This is especially important for the large momentum acceptance antiproton and RIB ion-optical modes. To improve the dynamic aperture and to reach necessary time resolution for TOF sextupole and octupole corrections are planned to be applied in the ring.

articleTitle: Beam dynamics simulation in the proton therapy SC linac with energy up to 240 MeV
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Results of the beam dynamics simulation in the superconducting for a radiation therapy proton linac with energy 240 MeV will presented. The main parameters of the accelerator allowing holding the beam envelope lower than 5 mm will be chosen. A possibility of beam transmission coefficient achievement higher than 95% will be shown. Methods of energy particles adjustment will discussed.

articleTitle: Beam dynamics in klystrons and waveguide, filled with dielectric, considering beam loading
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: During design of such non-periodic structures as cavities of multi cell klystron, waveguide filled with dielectric and generator of radiation in sub-mm range the key issue is beam dynamics investigation considering beam loading. Motion equations for beam of high brilliance will be obtained considering both quasi static Coulomb component of self field of the beam and high frequency radiation field. Excitation equations will be solved to calculate the radiation field. The mathematical model will be developed and calculations for Coulomb component will be carried out. Some test results of beam dynamic simulation will be shown.

articleTitle: Dynamics of the thermal state of the foil scanned with an electron beam
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A beam with an average power up to 500 kW is extracted from a vacuum volume of an accelerator through a system of foil-closed windows used alternately. In each window the beam scans a rectangular area 2500 × 40 mm in size. The ANSYS code was used to study temperature fluctuations of the foil and foil-supporting grid heated with the beam.

articleTitle: Optimization of electric field distribution inside CH-resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Distribution of the E-field amplitude on the axes inside multi-gap CH-resonators has a significant influence at the beam dynamics. High accelerating gain requires uniform field distribution on the beam axes. The field tuning task was solved using complex pilon design. Final cavity geometry, methodology and main electrodynamics characteristics are presented.

articleTitle: Time-dependent instantaneous frequency theory of charged particle motion in electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: We derived differential equations that describe nonlinear time-dependence of phase and instantaneous frequency for charged particles motion in electromagnetic fields in vacuum devices, with or without uniform magnetic field. The developed instantaneous frequency concept can be applied for method and technique development of vacuum electron or ion devices, e.g., mass spectrometers.

articleTitle: Plasma current and shape stabilization in tokamaks on the base of H2 and H-infinity problems solutions
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The problem of current and shape plasma stabilization in tokamaks is considered. The scheme of stabilization based on the H2 and H-infinity optimization problems solutions is proposed.

articleTitle: Differential evolution algorithm for charge particle beam transfer line optic optimization
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In this paper we describe software based on the differential evolution algorithm. The main software feature is the opportunity to optimize any single pass optical structures. We will discuss the software features, numerical algorithm and results of its application to optimize beam transfer lines of synchrotron radiation light source SIBERIA.

articleTitle: Method for a statistical estimation of the beam characteristics and structure parameters for the dispersion accelerator parts
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The regularization and combination methods were applied to treat the small number of experimental results. The proposed algorithm permits to calculate the transverse phase space parameters, center dynamics, momentum spread of the beam as well as the structure dispertion characteristics. The reliability of the calculation results and carried out measurements is estimated.

articleTitle: Investigation of the electric wind velocity subject to the electrode system design in plasma chemical reactor
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Experimental investigations of the electrode system design influence on air electric wind velocity in plasma chemical reactor are presented. The velocity growth with quantity of the corona-forming electrodes increasing is demonstrated. An analytical calculation of the electric wind velocity is performed.

articleTitle: Drive beam recombination optimization at CTF3
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The CLIC Test Facility (CTF3) installed at CERN has a scaled version of the CLIC design Drive-Beam Recombination Complex (DBRC). This complex is designed to recombine a long electron train into a shorter one but with increased bunch frequency and pulse current. A generic feedback algorithm to solve (quasi-)linear systems has been implemented in Matlab and it is used to optimize the process by tuning the energy of the incoming beam and steer the orbits in the different lines, as well matching the design dispersion. Current results and possible room for further optimization will be shown.

articleTitle: Solid state point emitters of metal ions
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: Field desorption, high temperature filed evaporation and atom surface diffusion were used for continuous ion beam generation. Narrow stationary fluxes of alkaline and refractory metal ions were obtained. Emission areas were reduced using thermo-field treatment. Angle distributions of ion trajectories in the beam were measured.

articleTitle: Magnets of Super Heavy Elements Facility
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The design of two magnets of Super Heavy Elements Facility is presented. The magnets are the parts of injection and extraction systems of DC-280 cyclotron. The design is based on three-dimensional calculation of the magnet field carried out by using OPERA 3D program code.

articleTitle: The hydrodynamic approach to the space charge problem modeling
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: In the paper the hydrodynamic approach taking into account the space charge effect is considered. In the framework of the model proposed the solutions model problems is obtained by the numerical methods. The comparison of these solutions with the known analytical ones and with the solutions, by PIC or PP - methods were obtained, was made. The obtaining solutions accuracy analysis was made.

articleTitle: Field simulation of M47 bending magnet for beam control
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The field of M47 bending magnet for the beam channel is calculated by an integral method. Corresponding formulas for the numerical solution of the magnetostatic problem are written. The three-dimensional field distribution is presented. The magnet design choice and optimization performed. The results in graphs and tables are given.

articleTitle: Method of producing a flow of finely divided particles using jet diaphragm discharge in the magnetogasdynamic (Mgd) mode
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: A method is described of producing a flow of finely divided particles using a pulsed jet diaphragm discharge (JDD) in vacuum. This method enables one to produce high-velocity (up to 30 km/s and higher) flows of stable microparticles of different chemical compositions sized 0.1μm to 900μm under vacuum conditions (pvac= 10-4-1.0 Pa). The possibility is demonstrated of employing this method for the simulation of combined impact made on the surface of optical materials by flows of micrometeoroids and finely divided particles of different sizes and velocities resulting from anthropogenic pollution of outer space in low circumterrestrial orbits.

articleTitle: Generator of the particle beam with the exact values of the second order moments
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: For beam distribution function dependent on the quadratic form of the phase space variables the particle generator is presented. The matrix of the form is inverse matrix of the second order moments. The exact values of the moments are fixed by means of a linear transformation of the phase space variables.

articleTitle: The solenoid type magnetic field detector modeling
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The solenoid type magnetic field detector modeling was made. The problem of the maximum domain size obtaining with the high degree magnetic field homogeneous is considered. The geometrical form of the iron core and current coil were taken into account, when the optimization was made. The different detector configurations were obtained and they comparisons were made.

articleTitle: The problem of adaptive optimum control in Markov processes
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The problem of synthesis of optimum strategy is considered for Dynamic of systems where a part of basic information, required forthe construction of the optimal control is lacking. A method for finding the synthesis of the optimal strategy, based on a recurrent algorithm for computing conditional densitiesis suggested. The basic device at an establishment of the fact of convergence in the given work is the information measure of a mismatch between estimated distribution and an estimation. As such measure so-called information number Kulbaka - Ley-blerais taken. In work convergence of the offered procedure is established.

articleTitle: Water vapor influence on the proton component of the hydrogen Penning discharge
publicationTitle: 2014 20th International Workshop on Beam Dynamics and Optimization (BDO)
abstract: The high atomic to molecular ion ratio is important for hydrogen ion sources. Experimental investigation of the water vapor injection into the hydrogen Penning discharge of the ion source has been made. Such injection increases the proton component of the ion beam and changes emittance with the same discharge parameters.
